title: threadlight-connect data contract
description: Emitted by threadlight-connect (scripts/connect.py::extract_contract). Records ONLY the fields a tool source actually reads (subscript access = required, `.get()` access = optional) — never sample keys that are merely present but unread. Customer-specific field mapping is out of scope; this is a conformance contract, not a transform.

name.description: The field name as read from the source object (row['id'] -> 'id').

required.description: true when read via subscript (obj['field']); false when only ever read via .get().

type.description: Inferred from the sample when the field is present there; null when no evidence exists.

cardinality.description: Inferred from the sample; null when no evidence exists.
